claim: Residual localization ambiguity is dominated by STRUCTURAL FAULT EQUIVALENCE, not by test-scheme weakness. Collision sets whose members lie adjacent on the same signal path are identical under every input vector and cannot be split by any test scheme.
classical_correspondence: this is the fault-collapsing equivalence relation used in ATPG since the 1960s; a stuck-at on a gate output and the same stuck-at on the net it drives are the same physical fault
consequence_for_acceptance: the per-circuit exact-site floor assumes a resolution finer than equivalence classes permit on circuits with deep equivalence chains
consequence_for_output_format: a candidate SET is the correct answer - it is the fault equivalence class. Reporting a single site would be less correct, not more.
not_claimed: that adjacency proves equivalence in every case - it is a strong structural indicator, not a formal per-fault proof
anything about circuits that have not been captured
that a different fault model (delay, bridging) would behave identically
